settings.custom_css:
selector { flex-wrap: nowrap; transition: background-color .15s; }
@media (max-width: 1024px) { selector { flex-wrap: wrap; } }
selector { font: 700 18px/1.2 Montserrat, sans-serif; color: #231B2B; text-transform: lowercase; }

settings.title: Tipo
settings.custom_css:
selector { align-self: flex-start; }
selector .elementor-heading-title { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; background: #B4A5F5; white-space: nowrap; }

settings.title: Título del evento
settings.custom_css:
selector a { color: inherit; }
selector a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

selector .elementor-shortcode { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; background: #231B2B; color: #FFE25C; font: 700 14px/1.3 Montserrat, sans-serif; }
selector .elementor-shortcode:empty { display: none; }
